title: 皐月賞の後に・変えてやる

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After Gold City finishes the Satsuki Sho, a few voices within the audience can be heard commenting on her running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems they might come around to recognizing the "real Gold City" if she keeps up this momentum. Her hopes remain high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next, she'll win the Japanese Derby to claim the reputation of strongest in her generation!
